additional_sources.title: ODE Asset Management: OSPAR Public Statement 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official OPRED-hosted statement exposes explicit 2024 platform-level CO2e totals for Babbage, Wenlock, Kilmar, Garrow, Tolmount and Blythe. All are offshore UKCS assets and are blocked from England cadastral parcel promotion.

additional_sources.title: Ithaca Energy Environmental Performance Report 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official report summary contains Scope 1 CO2e context, but tool-extracted two-column ordering is ambiguous; no new numeric row is promoted until page/table visual structure can be verified.

additional_sources.title: EnQuest PLC UKCS Environmental Statement 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official statement explicitly reports 287,324 tonnes CO2e from 2024 UK offshore operations where EnQuest is duty holder. This is an operator-portfolio total, not a cadastral facility parcel value.

guard_contract.MEASUREMENT_CANDIDATE: Reported or monitored source data requires explicit scope/facility, pollutant or gas, quantity, unit, period and method provenance. Offshore measurements remain facility or portfolio level and cannot become England cadastral parcel values.
guard_contract.BINDING_CANDIDATE: Permit or facility data supports identity/binding only; no emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.SPATIAL_CANDIDATE: Map/grid/boundary data supports spatial matching only; no measured emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.SOURCE_UPGRADE: Collection, guidance, aggregate or ambiguous-layout records cannot become parcel GHG without compatible observed quantity and verified parcel geometry.

web_research_basis: Fresh official GOV.UK/OPRED research on 2026-07-27. ODE machine-readable PDF text yielded six explicit platform totals. Existing Shell and CNOOC batch-177 sources yielded explicit portfolio totals without being double-counted as new sources. EnQuest adds one explicit portfolio total. Ithaca remains source-only because machine-readable column order is ambiguous. PDF screenshot calls were attempted but government asset cache/size limits prevented visual screenshots; no OCR or chart inference was used.
